effective_epochs.epoch_indexing: one-based (epoch 1 = first pass through the dataset)

shrimpdb3.best_checkpoint_source: Ultralytics EarlyStopping log: "Best results observed at epoch 6, best model saved as best.pt."
shrimpdb3.early_stop_reason: patience=15 triggered: validation metric did not improve for 15 epochs after the best checkpoint at epoch 6; training stopped at epoch 21.
shrimpdb3.note: best_validation_checkpoint_epoch is taken from the Ultralytics EarlyStopping log message. The minimum val/loss epoch in results.csv is reported as a secondary signal only.

combined4.best_checkpoint_source: inferred from minimum val/loss across results.csv (Ultralytics did not emit an EarlyStopping message); the project does not record the exact best.pt epoch explicitly.
combined4.early_stop_reason: patience=15 was not triggered; training completed the full 30-epoch budget.

effective_epochs.note: best_validation_checkpoint_epoch is determined from authoritative Ultralytics log evidence where available (ShrimpDB-3) and from results.csv minimum val/loss otherwise (Combined-4).

application_test_metrics.note: These values are reproduced directly from artifacts/evaluation/combined4/best_pt/metrics_raw.json. They are the test metrics of the validation-selected best.pt checkpoint.

ShrimpDB-3 and Combined-4 use different class spaces (3 vs 4); direct overall comparison is not controlled.
ShrimpDB-3 executed through epoch 21 (best at epoch 6, patience=15 triggered). Combined-4 completed full 30 epochs.

Research code only; not a veterinary diagnostic system.
